title: Case #4 — Redshifted radio galaxies · Arp 299, 11.9 GHz (Band 5b), z = 0.50
description: SKA-Mid AA* observation of the Arp 299 continuum model rescaled from z = 0.0109 to z = 0.50 in Band 5b: 11.85 GHz centre, 5000 MHz in 64 channels, 600 s around transit. WSClean multiscale imaging at Briggs robust -2, 2048 x 2048 pixels over 72 arcsec, 10000 iterations with mgain 0.5. One of 18 Arp 299 runs (native redshift and z = 0.15–2.00, in Bands 2, 5a and 5b) behind the redshift sequence.
